derivation: from H4414 (מָלַח) (in its denominative sense); understood as land (H776 (אֶרֶץ))
def: properly, salted (i.e. land), i.e. a desert

occurrences.text: Whose house I have made the wilderness, and the barren land his dwellings.
A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.
For he shall be like the heath in the desert, and shall not see when good cometh; but shall inhabit the parched places in the wilderness, in a salt land and not inhabited.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
